integration_boundaries_not_core_defects.observation: verify_archive verifies bytes from the supplied stream current position. A synthetic prefix+payload stream positioned at payload succeeds for that payload. It cannot certify a file prefix, initial offset or inode/size by itself.
integration_boundaries_not_core_defects.required_caller_action: Native independent reviewer must open stable bounded whole-file handles at offset0, bind fstat size/device/inode/no-symlink and fresh producer metadata after actual exit, then call all18 archive verifications. This is consistent with the delivery explicitly leaving file handling and full independent reviewer unimplemented.
